logs.title: SPECFEM3D MPI configuration
logs.summary: Ran the SPECFEM3D mesher in an HPC environment and confirmed the MPI process count must match the mesh configuration.
logs.summaryZh: 在 HPC 環境執行 SPECFEM3D mesher，確認 MPI process count 必須與 mesh configuration 一致。
logs.problem: MPI process count did not match the model configuration.
logs.problemZh: MPI 執行程序數與模型設定不一致。
logs.fix: Used a process count consistent with the configuration.
logs.fixZh: 改用與設定一致的 process count。
logs.lesson: Parallel programs often encode assumptions in configuration files, not only command-line arguments.
logs.lessonZh: 平行程式的限制常寫在設定檔中，不只是在命令列參數。
logs.nextStep: Turn the record into a high-school friendly parallel computing activity.
logs.nextStepZh: 整理成高中生可理解的平行運算體驗內容。
